questions.question: Which two water streams meet at Tandi near Keylong in Himachal Pradesh?
questions.solution: Chandra and Bhaga. Chenab originates Tandi Lahaul Spiti HP; sacred confluence Chandra-Bhaga.

questions.question: In which type of climate are deciduous forests and tree-shredded grasslands found?
questions.solution: Tropical wet and dry climate. Monsoon climates Aw Köppen; sal (Shorea) forests, savanna grasslands India Africa.

questions.question: The region of the Earth's atmosphere where weather events occur is known as the:
questions.solution: troposphere. 0-12km planetary boundary layer; convection, weather phenomena 75% atmosphere mass.

questions.question: Which of the following can help in conservation of water?
questions.option_3: Halving the supply of drinking water
questions.solution: Rainwater harvesting. Rooftop collection, recharge wells; traditional khadin, tanka, eris water conservation.

questions.question: महासागरीय पटल (oceanic crust) अधिकांशतः विभिन्न प्रकार के बेसाल्ट से बनी होती है जो समुद्र तल के नीचे कितने किलोमीटर तक फैली होती है?
questions.solution: 5-10 km. Oceanic basalt layer Moho discontinuity; continental 30-50km granite-gneiss.

questions.question: A geographic region that has separate but similar ecosystems characterised by a distinct climate is called a(n) ________.
questions.solution: biome. Large-scale ecosystems climate-driven; tundra, taiga, rainforest distinct flora-fauna.

questions.question: ​What is the term used to describe the process by which water from oceans, lakes and rivers is converted into vapour and rises into the atmosphere?
questions.solution: Evaporation. Liquid-vapor phase change solar heat; 90% ocean evaporation fuels water cycle.

questions.question: What is the process of ocean acidification?
questions.option_2: Decrease in pH due to carbon dioxide absorption
questions.solution: Decrease in pH due to carbon dioxide absorption. CO2 forms carbonic acid; pteropod shells dissolve, coral bleaching.

questions.question: Which layer of the Earth's atmosphere is responsible for protecting life on Earth by blocking harmful terrestrial solar radiation?
questions.solution: Stratosphere. 15-50km ozone layer UV-B absorption; temperature inversion stable layer.

questions.question: The Gulf Stream is a fast, warm ocean current in which ocean?
questions.solution: Atlantic Ocean. North Atlantic gyre warm current; Gulf Stream temperate Europe climate moderation.

questions.question: Tura is situated on which hill, which comes under the mild extremely humid agro-climatic zone?
questions.solution: Garo Hills. Meghalaya West Garo Hills Tura; 900-1,800m humid subtropical rice, betel.

questions.question: How much of the world's water is estimated to exist as freshwater?
questions.solution: 2.5%. 97.5% saline; 69% glaciers/icecaps, 30% groundwater, 0.3% surface freshwater.

questions.question: In astronomy, Cassiopeia is a constellation in the northern sky that is easily identified by its cluster of how many bright stars?
questions.solution: 5. W-shape Cassiopeia A ancient supernova remnant; circumpolar northern hemisphere.

questions.question: ___________ is a type of carbonate sedimentary rock. It is mainly composed of the minerals calcite and aragonite.
questions.solution: Limestone. CaCO3 sedimentary biogenic/chemical; karst topography, caves, fossiliferous.

questions.question: The asthenosphere is a mechanically weak layer beneath which part of Earth? It is characterised by low seismic wave velocities and high attenuation.
questions.solution: Lithosphere. Asthenosphere upper mantle 100-200km ductile convection plates float.

questions.question: Which religion has the largest population in Nepal?
questions.solution: Hinduism. 81% Nepalis Hindu; Pashupatinath, Lumbini Buddha birthplace syncretic.

questions.question: When trapped water in an aquifer is surrounded by layers of impermeable rock or clay, which apply positive pressure to the water, it is known as:
questions.solution: artesian aquifer. Confined positive pressure flowing wells; Great Artesian Basin Australia.

questions.question: Which of the following neighbouring countries of India has a state religion as Islam?
questions.solution: Pakistan. Constitution declares Islam state religion; sharia courts parallel judiciary.

questions.question: Which was an ancient ocean that existed approximately 250 to 50 million years ago before the evolution of the Indian Ocean?
questions.solution: Tethys sea. Mesozoic ocean between Gondwana-Laurasia; Himalaya orogeny subduction.

questions.question: When was the National Watershed Development Project for Rainfed Areas (NWDPRA) launched in India?
questions.solution: 1990-91. NWDPRA rainfed watershed development; soil-water conservation 25 ha micro-watersheds.

questions.question: What is the meaning of geological time?
questions.option_3: Geological events over millions of years
questions.solution: Geological events over millions of years. Eons, eras, periods, epochs; Phanerozoic 541Ma-present.

questions.question: Which climate zone is characterised by hot and humid conditions throughout the year?
questions.solution: Tropical. Af-Am Köppen high temperature >18°C coldest month; equatorial rainforests.

questions.question: ​Which is the national fruit of Bangladesh?
questions.solution: Jackfruit. Kathal national fruit Bangladesh; largest tree fruit, vegetarian meat substitute.

questions.question: Which of the following neighbouring countries of India has the lowest population density?
questions.solution: Bhutan. 86/km² lowest among neighbors; mountainous terrain low population density.

questions.question: In geology, Sima (the lower layer of Earth's crust) is made of an assemblage of rocks rich in ________ and magnesium. These two minerals are the most abundance minerals in the oceanic crust.
questions.solution: silicate. Sima SiO2-MgO mafic oceanic crust; sial Si-Al felsic continental.
